previous_statement: Apply lem-maincb-direct-corner-envelope with c0=W.c0_cb to the nonempty set R=U union V. It gives A_R an extended L^0*epsilon-C*-algebra structure and bounds its projection, subordination, and complementarity errors by max{c0,L^0}*epsilon=L^0*epsilon. Because W.L >= L^0, weakening these defect bounds records the valid Stage-3 target tolerance epsilon_R:=W.L*epsilon and bounds those errors by W.L*epsilon.
new_statement: Apply lem-maincb-direct-corner-envelope with c0=W.c0_cb to the nonempty set R=U union V, using node 1.2.1 for epsilon<=e_env^0. With the normalized witnesses fixed in node 1.1.1, it gives P_R a c0*epsilon-projection bound, gives A_R an extended L^0*epsilon-C*-algebra structure, and bounds every subordination and complementarity error by L^0*epsilon. Since epsilon>=0 and c0<=L^0<=W.L, all these errors are at most W.L*epsilon. The same tolerance monotonicity used in choosing L^0 lets the certified L^0*epsilon ambient structure be recorded at the weaker Stage-3 tolerance epsilon_R:=W.L*epsilon. Therefore the direct-corner external certifies precisely the ambient record and error bounds claimed in node 1.2.
